text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

You're a man, the appointee is a man, and the panel was all men. Sex discrimination against you is therefore very hard to argue — if anything, the composition points the other way. Raising it would weaken your credibility on the points that actually help you.

Your real case is on the merits and on process: a completed PhD, six papers and four years' teaching against an unfinished PhD and two papers raises a genuine question about whether the stated qualification criteria were applied as advertised. And at a public university you are normally entitled to a written statement of reasons.

Send a formal written reminder citing the relevant transparency rules, with a deadline, and copy the HR or administrative head.
